inputs: User-owned YEP plugin folder or ZIP
guarantees: Every canonical plugin receives a compilation result.
Every extracted source candidate receives a final disposition.
No RequiresReview discovery is accepted in a golden catalog.
Every emitted feature satisfies the Phase 1 platform-neutral catalog contract.
Paired blocks include opening and closing patterns.
Generated feature keys are unique and deterministic.
Runtime parser evidence contains line numbers and hashes but no JavaScript source excerpts.
Long YEP help prose and parameter descriptions are not redistributed.
The compiler never executes plugin JavaScript.
The generated catalog can be loaded without the source bundle.
